# UI Foundations

> uGUI building blocks for strict MVC in Unity 6: `BaseClickController`, an invisible raycast target with an `OnClick()` override that replaces `Button`; `ViewStateMachine`, which shows one of several mutually exclusive looks with instant or fade transitions; and `UIGradientGroup`, which spreads one gradient across several Graphics. Keeps input and visuals apart. MIT licensed, pre-release (0.x), single author, no other users yet.
